name: ParentFieldSync
description: Copies selected Azure Boards field values from parent work items to their child work items.
author: Promicro

inputs.name: parentWorkItemType
inputs.label: Parent work item type
inputs.helpMarkDown: The exact Azure Boards work item type of the parent, for example `User Story` or `Product Backlog Item`.

inputs.name: childWorkItemType
inputs.label: Child work item type
inputs.helpMarkDown: The exact Azure Boards work item type to query and update.

inputs.name: fieldMappings
inputs.label: Field mappings
inputs.helpMarkDown: One mapping per line. Use `Source.ReferenceName` when source and target match, or `Source.ReferenceName=Target.ReferenceName` to map different fields.

inputs.name: preserveChildValueWhenParentEmpty
inputs.label: Preserve value when parent field is empty
inputs.helpMarkDown: When disabled, an empty parent field clears the corresponding child field.

inputs.name: preserveChildValueWhenNoParent
inputs.label: Preserve value when child has no parent
inputs.helpMarkDown: When disabled, mapped fields are cleared on child work items without a parent.

inputs.name: dryRun
inputs.label: Dry run
inputs.helpMarkDown: Reports intended updates without changing work items.
